newsitem.title: USA: NTN Communications names Sokol to COO post.
newsitem.headline: NTN Communications names Sokol to COO post.

text.p: NTN Communications Inc on Thursday said it has named Gerald Sokol to the post of chief operating officer in addition to his current responsibilities as chief financial officer.
Sokol replaces Daniel Downs, president, in the COO post. Downs remains president and will focus more on corporate strategy than day-to-day operations, a spokeswoman said.
"(Sokol) has the strategic vision, and financial discipline we desire for this position," Downs said in a statement. NTN produces interactive television and online entertainment.
